changed.title: The 5 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 3937373 is represented on the one-a-side promise by an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 10 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 10 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 5 => (3937373 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) C
changed.unlocks: Whether a NOT gate pays under a checked AND/OR floor of 11 on this side-5 graph, by leaving its classes of equal rows or columns unread.
changed.sketch: We hold no circuit of 10 gates; this is a search. This graph has a class of 2 equal columns, which a circuit with NOT gates may leave unread. Give a gate list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in two, at most 10 gates, judged by evaluation on the 25 promise inputs. The graph needs at least 11 AND/OR gates by a checked floor row (search 'mask 3937373'). An exhausted search is a report, not a proof.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 6 bipartite graph with mask 1948655 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 10 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (1948655 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 10
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 6 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 11 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 10; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 9 (on paper), a gap of 2. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 9 right, gate j writes wire 10 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 24 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.title: The two-lit function of the graph H on 6 points with mask 17051 on shared wires has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 9 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 9 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 6, C.eval (List.ofFn fun k : Fin 6 => decide (k = i ∨ k = j)) = (17051 : ℕ).testBit (6 * min i.val j.val + max i.val j.val)
changed.unlocks: the exact size of the two-lit-points function of this graph on six shared wires; the family shows where a NOT gate pays with no equal lines
changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 10 gates, a weak hand form (best over a few point orders and the complement plus a NOT, equal gates merged): NOT(0), AND(4,6), OR(0,1), NOT(8), AND(3,9), AND(2,8), OR(5,7), OR(10,12), OR(11,13), NOT(14) (inputs 0-5 are the points, gate k is wire 6 + k, output last). We hold no circuit of 9 gates; this is a search. No complete search of ours has run at six points.
